source_documents: Etat de l'art RL/État de l’art du Reinforcement Learning jusqu’en mai 2026.docx
core_claim: En 2026, offline RL, offline-to-online and sequence modeling are useful when interaction is costly or logs are valuable, but dataset coverage becomes the main bottleneck.
leakage_risks: Offline trajectory datasets must preserve chronological splits.
Do not train on trajectories generated from Test set feedback.
Do not claim deployable performance from offline-only backtest without online-style validation.
decision_rule: Use this card to prepare trajectory logging and offline datasets; do not prioritize Decision Transformer before PPO/RecurrentPPO baselines and non-RL benchmarks exist.
